title: heimdal.consent.granted payload (v1, contract-stub)
description: CONTRACT-STUB (Epic #3019 slice A4, #3041; FABLE_COMPANION §11#3, §6.1): schema-representable now, no runtime producer/consumer lands with this slice. The consent ledger runtime (grants table, standing self_record grant, capture-time check) is A5 -- out of scope here. This schema fixes the shape a future grant-issuance event will carry so the consent.grant_ref referenced by heimdal.observation.published.v1 (HEIM-3) resolves to a well-defined record once the ledger runtime lands.

grant_ref.description: Stable identity of the issued grant; the value later referenced by consent.grant_ref on published observation events.

basis.description: Grant basis (§1.3/§6.1). v1 build-now: self_record. Place/session grants: contract-stub (§11#4).

granted_by.description: Who granted consent (operator identity, in v1 the single-user operator).

scope_ref.description: Optional place/session scope the grant is bound to (§6.1 place_optin/session_optin, v2).
